entries.reason: AH999 (l.842, EXIT) is entered only by falling out of `IF WS-STORM-DRAIN = 'N'` (l.833). Its true arm ends in EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE(MY-ABEND-CODE) CANCEL, which does not return, and its false arm needs WS-STORM-DRAIN 'Y', which no run reaches (see the entry for l.833: the only MOVE 'Y' is in the AFCR/AFCS/AFCT arm that ends in EXEC CICS RETURN). Nothing PERFORMs or GO TOs AH999.

`IF WS-STORM-DRAIN = 'N'` (l.833) is false only when WS-STORM-DRAIN is 'Y'. WS-STORM-DRAIN starts 'N' (VALUE, l.173) and the only statement that sets it 'Y' is l.745, inside the WHEN 'AFCR'/'AFCS'/'AFCT' arm of the EVALUATE MY-ABEND-CODE; that arm ends in an unconditional MOVE 'N' TO COMM-SUCCESS / MOVE '2' TO COMM-FAIL-CODE / EXEC CICS RETURN (l.825-828) before END-EVALUATE, so control never reaches l.833 with 'Y'. The AD2Z arm and the codes no arm names (EVALUATE none arm, l.716) arrive with 'N' and take the true arm (EXEC CICS ABEND).
